name: Mandarake
summary: Legendary Tokyo otaku auction & retail empire authenticating vintage manga, rare out-of-print doujinshi, and retro PC eroge worldwide.
ranking_rationale: Gold standard for rare vintage doujinshi, animation cels & collector eroge, weighed against slower per-store shipping consolidation if ordering from multiple Mandarake branches.

pricing.notes: Pricing and promos change frequently; verify directly at official checkout.

pros: Gold standard for rare vintage doujinshi, animation cels & collector eroge
Full English global checkout & DHL/EMS worldwide shipping
cons: Slower per-store shipping consolidation if ordering from multiple Mandarake branches
Auction/scarce rare items command steep prices
